claims.text: Andaman Polymer Group has not reported any recent changes to polypropylene capacity at Map Ta Phut following its 2025 scheduled steam cracker turnaround; all downstream units resumed normal rates with no change to capacity.

citations.quote: The company reported no change to capacity and said all downstream units have resumed normal rates.

claims.text: Andaman Polymer Group has taken a final investment decision on a third polypropylene line at Map Ta Phut, designed for 300 kta and using gas-phase technology.

citations.quote: The line is designed for 300 kta and will use gas-phase technology, consistent with the site's existing two lines.

claims.text: The third polypropylene line at Map Ta Phut will be supplied with propylene from the existing Map Ta Phut propylene unit, with no additional cracker capacity required.

citations.quote: The company said propylene will be supplied from the existing Map Ta Phut propylene unit, and that no additional cracker capacity is required.

claims.text: Mechanical completion for the third polypropylene line at Map Ta Phut has been revised from Q2 2028 to Q4 2028 due to delays in environmental permitting and ground conditions requiring additional piling.

citations.quote: mechanical completion has moved from the second quarter of 2028 to the fourth quarter of 2028. Two factors were cited. First, the environmental permit amendment covering the revised flare tie-in took longer than the company had assumed in its original schedule. Second, the appointed civil contractor requested a schedule extension after encountering unsuitable ground conditions at the foundation stage, which required additional piling.

claims.text: The capital estimate for the third polypropylene line at Map Ta Phut remains unchanged despite the schedule delay.

citations.quote: Andaman said the capital estimate is unchanged and that the delay does not affect the existing two polypropylene lines or the cracker.

coverage_note: Evidence is limited to company press releases. No third-party confirmation or additional details on the capital estimate or commissioning schedule are available.
